svg.title: Four Checks Before Accepting the Engagement
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-statutory-structure-decision-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Accepting the Engagement; subtitle: Each branch either proceeds with evidence or stops for redesign.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The numeric values indicate check sequence, not risk scores. Apply federal statutes and clauses according to their scope and the solicitation. For municipal work, identify local ethics and purchasing rules separately; federal funding can add requirements.; caption: Run all four checks before promising services. A favorable result on fee structure does not resolve procurement integrity, kickbacks, or unlawful performance arrangements.; stages: label: Contingent-fee structure; value: Proceed with documented lawful compensation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Does compensation depend on securing a government contract? If yes, stop for analysis under 41 U.S.C. 3901, FAR Subpart 3.4, and applicable FAR 52.203-5 terms, including the narrowly defined bona fide employee or agency exception. If no, document service deliverables and continue.; label: Procurement integrity; value: Proceed only with authorized information; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Does the work involve protected bid, proposal, or source selection information, or restricted employment contacts? If yes, stop the affected activity and obtain a documented resolution under 41 U.S.C. 2102–2104 and FAR 3.104. Otherwise record information provenance and continue.; label: Kickbacks and influence; value: Reject improper payments or preferential treatment; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Is anything of value being offered for improper favorable treatment in a prime contract or related subcontract? If yes, reject the arrangement and address applicable reporting duties. Apply 41 U.S.C. 8702 and FAR Subpart 3.5; separately assess public-official bribery under 18 U.S.C. 201 where applicable.; label: Performance and eligibility; value: Proceed only with executable lawful workshare; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Can the eligible contractor perform the required workshare and substantiate intermediary value? If no, redesign or decline. Evaluate 13 CFR 125.6, applicable FAR 52.219-14 and 52.215-23 terms, and ostensible-subcontractor exposure under 13 CFR 121.103(h). If yes, retain the calculation and responsibility matrix.

text.title: Four Checks Before Accepting the Engagement
text.tspan: Four Checks Before Accepting the Engagement

circle.title: label: Contingent-fee structure; value: Proceed with documented lawful compensation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Does compensation depend on securing a government contract? If yes, stop for analysis under 41 U.S.C. 3901, FAR Subpart 3.4, and applicable FAR 52.203-5 terms, including the narrowly defined bona fide employee or agency exception. If no, document service deliverables and continue.

text.title: Does compensation depend on securing a government contract? If yes, stop for analysis under 41 U.S.C. 3901, FAR Subpart 3.4, and applicable FAR 52.203-5 terms, including the narrowly defined bona fide employee or agency exception. If no, document service deliverables and continue.

circle.title: label: Procurement integrity; value: Proceed only with authorized information; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Does the work involve protected bid, proposal, or source selection information, or restricted employment contacts? If yes, stop the affected activity and obtain a documented resolution under 41 U.S.C. 2102–2104 and FAR 3.104. Otherwise record information provenance and continue.

text.title: Does the work involve protected bid, proposal, or source selection information, or restricted employment contacts? If yes, stop the affected activity and obtain a documented resolution under 41 U.S.C. 2102–2104 and FAR 3.104. Otherwise record information provenance and continue.

circle.title: label: Kickbacks and influence; value: Reject improper payments or preferential treatment; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Is anything of value being offered for improper favorable treatment in a prime contract or related subcontract? If yes, reject the arrangement and address applicable reporting duties. Apply 41 U.S.C. 8702 and FAR Subpart 3.5; separately assess public-official bribery under 18 U.S.C. 201 where applicable.

text.title: Is anything of value being offered for improper favorable treatment in a prime contract or related subcontract? If yes, reject the arrangement and address applicable reporting duties. Apply 41 U.S.C. 8702 and FAR Subpart 3.5; separately assess public-official bribery under 18 U.S.C. 201 where applicable.

If no, redesign or decline. Evaluate 13 CFR 125.6, applicable FAR 52.219-14 and 52.215-23 terms, and ostensible-subcontractor exposure under 13 CFR 121.103(h). If yes, retain the calculation and responsibility matrix.

Evaluate 13 CFR 125.6, applicable FAR 52.219-14 and 52.215-23 terms, and ostensible-subcontractor exposure under 13 CFR 121.103(h). If yes, retain the calculation and responsibility matrix.

Assumptions: The numeric values indicate check sequence, not risk scores. Apply federal statutes and clauses according to their scope and the solicitation. For municipal work, identify local ethics and purchasing rules separately; federal funding can add requirements.
